affected_scope: Only reserved native status path not yet executed; no forecast or canonical historical scores contaminated
counterexample: A fresh local observed_UTC plus HTTP Age 7200 or HTTP Date two hours old must not authenticate current status.
bounded_read_note: Before each final request, remaining application body-byte budget is computed from actual ledger; body read cannot exceed the smaller remaining/per-response cap. An exactly bound-length response is conservatively rejected as possibly truncated, without reading another byte.
